definition.description: On a clear stable floor or mat, sit in a comfortable bent-knee 90/90 position with optional light hands behind the body. Transition both legs under control to the opposite 90/90 side through the available hip-rotation range, then return without rising. One cycle is left 90/90 to right 90/90 and back. This excludes a shin-box get-up, walking, lunge, kick, assessment, and forced end range.
